summary: First E2E test of Block Architect (Expo SDK 54 mobile puzzle game). Tested all 14 features listed in the review request via Playwright at 420x900 portrait viewport against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Skipped real drag-to-grid placement as instructed (only validated tray-piece-* testIDs and visual rendering). Cleared localStorage to simulate first-launch. 100% pass rate — every flow works correctly: daily rewards auto-modal, coin claim (100→120), full top bar, skyline+moon+sun rendering, 8x10 grid, 3 neon tray pieces, undo badge, all modals (Settings, Shop, Season Pass), modal-close buttons, mocked IAP subscription path (loader → ACTIVE state), energy ∞ after pass.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only — no impact on functionality. Worth cleaning up before Play Store submission.

Browser-only warning: 'play() failed because the user didn't interact with the document first' from background music auto-start. Harmless on web preview; real device flow is unaffected because Android auto-play policy differs.

action_items: (Low priority) Migrate deprecated React Native Web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, textShadow* -> textShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings.
(Low priority) Guard startMusic() behind a first user-gesture on web to avoid the auto-play console error in the preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: GameScreen.tsx is ~913 lines — close to the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting modal handlers, daily-reward logic, and persistence effects into smaller hooks (useDailyRewards, usePersistedGame, useMonetizationFlows) for maintainability.
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes — excellent test coverage out of the box.
Mocked IAP (purchaseProduct) and rewarded ad (showRewardedAd) flows resolve cleanly after ~1s simulated loader; architecture is clean for swapping in real RevenueCat / AdMob in a dev-client build.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage at start to force first-launch flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs (daily-claim-btn, daily-day-0..6, topbar-score/streak/coins/settings/energy, undo-button, tray-piece-0/1/2, settings-sfx/music/haptics/restart, shop-buy-hints/undos/hammer/energy, shop-open-pass, shop-coin-balance, pass-subscribe, modal-close) are stable. Drag-to-grid placement via Playwright is unreliable due to Reanimated 4 panning — validate in real device / Expo Go instead. Pass-active state persists via AsyncStorage; remember to localStorage.clear() if you need a clean session.
